preconditions.description: The length of the string s is between 1 and 1000.

preconditions.expression: all('a' <= c <= 'z' for c in s)
preconditions.description: All characters in the string s are lowercase Latin letters.

postconditions.expression: return_value[0] == 'YES' if any(all(s[p * i - 1] == s[p * (i + 1) - 1] for i in range(1, len(s) // p)) for p in range(2, len(s) + 1) if all((p % d != 0 for d in range(2, int(p**0.5) + 1)))) else return_value[0] == 'NO'
postconditions.description: The first line of the output is 'YES' if there exists a permutation of the string s that satisfies the given condition for all prime numbers p ≤ |s|, otherwise it is 'NO'.

postconditions.expression: return_value[0] == 'YES' if return_value[1] is not None else return_value[0] == 'NO'
postconditions.description: If the first line is 'YES', the second line contains a valid permutation of the string s. If the first line is 'NO', the second line is omitted.
